text: 'Tung tung tung sahur': concept art, 1 designs to choose from, then up to 1 rounds of notes

concept: A LEGO model of a chunky stylised wooden cricket-bat-like character with a long rectangular brick body, a carved face, and short stubby arms and legs, standing upright on a display stand. (changed: Replaced the viral character's thin flat meme-image shape with a chunky stacked-brick plank body, since thin free-standing slabs aren't buildable.; Gave it a calm standing pose instead of the swinging/running motion seen in the meme videos.)

score 2/10: Doesn't read as the blocky bat owl; looks like a tall messy brown figure; Body is too tall/narrow — concept is a wide flat plank slab; Wings are small flat plates angled upward, missing the scalloped bat-wing silhouette

score 3/10: Reads as a lumpy brown blob, not a bat-like owl/monster at a glance; Wings are flat stud-up plate stacks sticking out sideways instead of angled scalloped bat wings; Extra pair of arm/wing stubs mid-body not in concept
